description: Use this when the user wants a static dealer vehicle-listing checklist for Germany, the US, the UK or a generic market, optionally for a new or used vehicle. Returns recommended fields, photo order, title pattern and description structure in English. It does not fetch or scrape any website or verify vehicle facts, and is not legal advice. No images or videos are generated. No listing is stored or changed; operational call metrics are logged. Do not use for checking live portal rules, retrieving ads, vehicle inspections or generating images or videos.

market.description: Market guidance; no legal compliance determination.
